Category of asset/liability:
Cash and cash equivalents, items in course of
collection, loans and advances to banks and
due from group companies
Valuation techniques applied:
Carrying amount since the amounts are
receivable on demand as at the reporting
date

Significant observable inputs:
Interest rates, expected lifetime credit losses,
prepayments rates and primary origination or
secondary market spreads

Valuation techniques applied: Prices quoted in an active market
Significant observable inputs:
Quoted yields and bid offer adjustment that
management has estimated as the reasonable
basis for applying the adjustment

Valuation techniques applied:
Discounted cash flow techniques and/or
option pricing models, such as the Black
Scholes model
Significant observable inputs: Spot price, interest rate and/ or volatility

Valuation techniques applied:
A substantial proportion of deposits mature
within 12 months and hence the fair value
approximates their carrying amounts.
